concerns.text: Principle VI (Materials Data Provenance) is violated: the plan does not obtain any raw magnetic‑property data from the Materials Project REST API, yet the constitution requires *all* raw data to come exclusively from Materials Project and OQMD. The Curie‑temperature branch is simply omitted, which does not satisfy the non‑negotiable provenance requirement.

The plan never mentions a `data_sources.yaml` file that records the exact OQMD release identifier (or any Materials Project endpoint version). Constitution VI mandates this file for every dataset download; its absence is a breach of both Principle VI and the Single Source of Truth principle.
